getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:01ab8e65-51a.description: About Wing AI Wing AI is a technology-enabled talent platform helping businesses scale with high-quality global talent and AI-powered support. We manage the full talent lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding to training and performance so companies can focus on what matters most. Trusted by thousands of teams worldwide, Wing AI combines human expertise with smart systems to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable execution for modern businesses. Role Overview We are looking for a Corporate Trainer to design, implement, and continuously improve learning and development programs for Wing AI’s internal (corporate) teams. This role will be instrumental in building a high-performance culture by equipping employees and leaders with the skills, knowledge, and behaviors needed to succeed in a fast-scaling, AI-enabled environment. You will partner closely with HR and business leaders to identify capability gaps, develop targeted training initiatives, and drive learning strategies that support performance, engagement, and succession planning. hmbltech-hmbl-tech:lever:9a220863-89c7-4.title: Talent Intake Specialist
hmbltech-hmbl-tech:lever:9a220863-89c7-4.description: HMBL is your premiere Talent Partner and Executive Search Solution. We were founded on the fact that technical recruiting is most fruitful via partnership --than it is transactional. We partner the most innovative, cutting-edge tech companies. HMBL stances its foundational values around transparency, overcommunication, and the desire to improve. We leverage best industry practices, historical and predictive data and AI to acquire the industry's top 5% of technical talent. Are you passionate about making the impossible possible? Are you interested in working with the best and brightest in the tech industry? Do you want to work on the front-lines of innovation? We have what you're looking for! Stay hungry. Stay HMBL. Job Title: Talent Intake Specialist Location: Remote (U.S.-based) Employment Type: Full-time As a Talent Intake Specialist, you’ll be the first point of contact for candidates entering our recruiting pipeline. Your job is to run structured virtual intake calls, assess fit, capture key information, and create a great first impression. You’ll play a critical role in qualifying talent for our recruiters and ensuring candidates feel supported and excited to move forward.
responsibilities: Conduct high-volume virtual intake calls with candidates daily (via Zoom or phone).
Collect and record candidate data in our CRM/ATS accurately and efficiently.
Explain open opportunities and screen for qualifications, interest, and availability.
Guide candidates through next steps and ensure smooth handoff to recruiters.
Represent our organization professionally and enthusiastically on every call.
Track daily metrics and continuously improve conversion and engagement rates.
qualifications: 1+ year of experience in customer service, recruiting, sales, marketing or similar.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Exceptional communication skills – able to engage candidates effectively, build relationships, and represent the company professionally.
Tech-savvy and resourceful – proficient in sourcing tools, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and Boolean search techniques.
Strong work ethic and self-motivation – takes ownership, meets deadlines, and goes the extra mile to find top talent.
Growth mindset – eager to learn, adapt, and continuously improve sourcing strategies.
Resilient and persistent – thrives in a fast-paced environment, embraces challenges, and doesn’t give up easily.
Highly professional and detail-oriented – maintains a high standard of professionalism, confidentiality, and organization.
Team player – collaborates effectively with teammates, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to drive hiring success.

infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.title: General Pipeline - FullStack Applied AI Engineer
infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY This is a general application for Full-Stack Applied AI Engineers across Infinity Constellation’s platform and portfolio of companies and the companies we build and support. Rather than applying to a specific role, you’ll be joining our talent network for current and future opportunities across the businesses we build and support. Because our hiring needs evolve quickly, applying does not necessarily mean there is an immediate opening that matches your background today. When a relevant opportunity arises, our team may reach out to discuss the specific company, project, scope, and timing. ABOUT INFINITY Infinity Constellation is a holding company building full-stack AI businesses. Our engineering teams work across a range of zero-to-one and growth-stage challenges, from rapidly prototyping new product ideas and building AI-native platforms to embedding directly with companies and clients to solve complex, real-world problems. We also build and evolve Gravity, our in-house software factory and agent hub used to accelerate how software is created across the Infinity ecosystem. We’re not a dev shop. We’re a focused network of builders who move quickly, reduce ambiguity, and create leverage across companies with AI at their core. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for sharp, resourceful, execution-focused engineers who thrive in high-autonomy environments and enjoy building at the intersection of full-stack software engineering, applied AI, product, and systems design. Depending on the opportunity, you might spend one week validating a new product idea through a rapid prototype and the next building production-grade AI workflows, internal platforms, or client-facing applications. Some engineers work directly on shared Infinity infrastructure, while others embed with portfolio companies or clients to solve high-impact technical problems. The common thread: you’ll be expected to turn ambiguity into working software, make pragmatic technical decisions, and own outcomes—not just code. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build and ship full-stack, AI-native products, internal platforms, prototypes, and production applications. - Design and implement agentic AI applications, LLM workflows, RAG systems, document-processing pipelines, and other applied AI solutions. - Translate ambiguous business, product, or client needs into scalable technical systems. - Build modern frontend experiences using frameworks such as React and Next.js. - Develop backend systems and APIs using Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Django, or similar technologies. - Design data models and work across relational, graph, vector, and hybrid database architectures. - Integrate commercial APIs, open-source models, automation platforms, and third-party tools to create leverage and accelerate execution. - Build asynchronous workflows, internal dashboards, admin tools, approval systems, and automation infrastructure. - Experiment quickly across frameworks and technologies while knowing when to optimize for speed versus long-term scalability. - Contribute to shared internal libraries, Infinity Commons, and Gravity, our software factory platform. - Collaborate directly with founders, product leaders, senior engineers, and, in some cases, clients to define problems and ship solutions. - Occasionally embed with an Infinity company or client team to support launches, unblock execution, or build zero-to-one products. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR We’re building a broad pipeline and recognize that the right level of experience may vary by opportunity. In general, we’re interested in engineers who bring: - Experience and comfort working directly with stakeholders and customers to translate business problems into working solutions - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping real products used by real users. - Fluency in Python and experience building AI-powered applications, workflows, or systems. - Full-stack development experience with modern web technologies such as React,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:87643a9e-7afa-.title: Principal Enterprise-Wide Applications Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:87643a9e-7afa-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Enterprise-Wide Applications Analyst based in the United States. This role supports enterprise resource planning and global supply chain operations within a complex, technology-driven environment. You will focus on SAP S/4 functionality, with particular emphasis on Supplier Management and related business processes. The position combines production support, systems administration, project delivery, testing, and continuous improvement. You will collaborate closely with business process experts, technical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver effective solutions. The role offers significant exposure to enterprise applications, system enhancements, upgrades, and transformation initiatives. You will work with technologies including SAP S/4, Ariba, and MDG while helping maintain reliable and compliant business processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact technology programs while developing your expertise across a broad enterprise landscape. Serve as a key liaison for business stakeholders, providing guidance on system changes, enhancement requests, maintenance activities, communications, and application strategy. Balance production support, project priorities, stakeholder engagement, and systems administration responsibilities to maintain reliable enterprise applications. Support end-to-end project activities, including planning, requirements analysis, test development and execution, security design, documentation, change management, deployment, and go-live activities. Participate in the implementation and optimization of automated systems, processes, and special projects designed to improve operational efficiency. Investigate application issues by analyzing data conditions, developing specifications, and collaborating with programmers and technical teams to resolve problems. Partner with business process experts and other SAP S/4 analysts on cross-functional initiatives involving Global Supply Chain and related functional areas. Contribute to system and development deployment planning, ensuring changes are properly coordinated and implemented. Ensure software changes and processes comply with established technical, security, and compliance standards. Test Supplier Management and Global Supply Chain functionality across incidents, enhancements, upgrades, service pack implementations, and disaster recovery initiatives. Apply knowledge of Ariba and Master Data Governance (MDG) to support enterprise supplier and supply chain processes. Maintain and validate system data needed for testing, troubleshooting, and solution development. Support continuous improvement by applying technical and functional expertise to develop solutions aligned with business objectives. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 1 year of relevant experience. Demonstrated experience participating in SAP S/4 lifecycle implementations and/or production support. Strong functional and technical knowledge of SAP S/4, particularly Supplier Management and Global Supply Chain processes. Working knowledge of SAP Ariba and Master Data Governance (MDG). Experience working across functional areas and understanding the interdependencies between Supplier Management, Global Supply Chain, and other enterprise functions. Ability to extract, analyze, and validate SAP table data for troubleshooting, testing, and business analysis. Experience supporting application enhancements, maintenance, system upgrades, and implementation activities. Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex issues and develop practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9346576-169c-.title: Contract AI Investing Content Writer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9346576-169c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Contract AI Investing Content Writer based in the United States. This is a flexible, fully remote contract opportunity for a financially savvy writer who can combine strong investment knowledge with AI-assisted content production. You’ll review and refine high-volume, AI-generated financial articles covering timely market and company events. The role focuses on adding the critical context investors need to distinguish meaningful developments from routine market noise. You’ll fact-check financial information, assess its significance, and produce concise, insightful commentary aligned with long-term investing principles. You’ll work within a content management system and collaborate with editorial and technology teams to continuously improve AI-generated outputs. The environment is fast-paced and autonomous, with an emphasis on accuracy, analytical thinking, curiosity, and high-quality financial journalism. A passion for investing, LLMs, and emerging AI technologies will help you thrive in this role. Review AI-generated financial article drafts in a content management system and assess them for accuracy, relevance, clarity, and substance. Fact-check financial data, company information, market developments, and other source material using reliable research methods and financial resources. Write concise, investor-focused commentary of approximately 150–300 words that explains the significance of news events and helps readers distinguish meaningful developments from routine activity. Apply sound investment judgment to contextualize events such as insider transactions, dividend announcements, earnings releases, and other company-specific developments. Edit AI-generated content substantively, improving its financial accuracy, analytical value, clarity, and usefulness rather than simply copyediting. Ensure content reflects a long-term, fundamentals-focused investment philosophy and maintains a consistent editorial voice. Manage a high volume of articles while meeting deadlines and maintaining rigorous standards for financial accuracy and editorial quality. Provide detailed, actionable feedback on AI-generated content and recurring issues to help prompt engineers improve model outputs and content workflows. Stay current with financial markets, investing concepts, company developments, and evolving AI and LLM technologies relevant to financial publishing. Requirements: Demonstrated understanding of financial concepts, investment terminology, markets, and the broader global financial landscape. Experience in journalism, financial writing, editing, research, or a closely related field, with a strong understanding of news writing, AP style, and journalistic ethics. Strong investment knowledge and the ability to evaluate whether financial news is genuinely material, largely noise, or somewhere in between. Proven fact-checking and research skills, including the ability to verify financial information, data, claims, and sources. Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial information into concise, accessible, and insightful commentary. Familiarity with content management systems, digital publishing tools, fact-checking technologies, and other tools used in financial media. Understanding of LLMs, AI-assisted content workflows, and the ability to read, interpret, and work effectively with AI prompts. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, particularly when working with financial figures and market-sensitive information. Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, and consistently meet deadlines in a high-volume environment. Self-motivated, financially curious, analytical, and comfortable exercising independent editorial judgment. Availability to commit to a minimum of 15 hours per week. Must reside in the United States. Benefits: Fully remote an

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:04cfab4d-5b14-4217.title: Sheet Metal Welding Technician
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:04cfab4d-5b14-4217.description: Sheet Metal Fabrication Welder Location: Newport News, VA Schedule: Monday–Friday | First Shift Compensation: Starting at $18.00/hour, with higher pay available based on experience and welding proficiency Opportunity Overview We are seeking a skilled Sheet Metal Fabrication Welder to join a growing manufacturing team. This position focuses on fitting, assembling, and welding precision sheet metal components according to engineering specifications, production requirements, and quality standards. The ideal candidate will have strong MIG welding experience, the ability to interpret fabrication drawings, and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced production environment.
responsibilities: Fit and weld sheet metal components using MIG welding processes.
Read work orders, blueprints, drawings, and welding symbols to determine project requirements.
Assemble and align parts using clamps, fixtures, and measuring tools.
Perform welding in flat, vertical, and overhead positions as required.
Inspect completed welds and assemblies to verify dimensional accuracy and quality standards.
Work with steel, aluminum, and other metal alloys.
Prepare materials through tack welding, grinding, heat bending, and related fabrication techniques.
Select appropriate welding methods based on material type and job specifications.
Perform routine equipment checks and assist with basic maintenance and troubleshooting.
Maintain a safe, organized work area and follow all workplace safety procedures.
Work efficiently to meet daily production goals and schedules.
qualifications: Minimum of 3 years of MIG welding experience in a manufacturing or production environment.
Experience welding light-gauge sheet metal materials.
Ability to read basic blueprints and understand welding symbols.
Experience using measuring tools such as calipers, straightedges, templates, and gauges.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
Ability to communicate effectively with supervisors and team members.
Ability to lift and move materials weighing up to 100 pounds.
Ability to stand, walk, bend, twist, squat, reach, and perform repetitive hand movements throughout the workday.
Comfortable working in varying temperatures commonly found in manufacturing facilities.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! Location: Speeders Car Wash 193 U.S. 46, Budd Lake, NJ, USA
